'''The Three Moons''' is an inn in the [[Tear (city)|City of Tear]], not far from [[The Dragon]].{{ref/book|11|21}}

==Activities==
[[Agardo Saranche]], innkeeper of The Dragon, offers to escort [[Rand al'Thor]] and his party up the street to The Three Moons, as all his large rooms are taken.{{ref/book|11|21}}
